{{Top}}
{{Citation}}
'''Protein''' was a form of food source for living beings.

==History==
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]] [[Sanctuary/Legends|Sanctuary]] exported protein, in the form of many tons of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]], to the Rebellion's cause every [[Standard year/Legends|year]].
